purpose: One final retrieval-selection experiment; offline only until a HOLDOUT-backed policy change is justified
corpus: 52 hash-pinned Apache DolphinScheduler public source snapshots

chunk_candidates.A: existing heading/paragraph chunks, max 1250 chars, no overlap, document key and heading in BM25 text
chunk_candidates.B: finer heading/paragraph chunks, max 650 chars, no overlap
chunk_candidates.C: heading-aware chunks, max 900 chars including 100-char same-heading overlap, document title in search text

retrievers: BM25 + E5 weighted reciprocal-rank fusion, branch pool 50 and rank constant 60
document_diversity_trial_dev_only: one max_chunks_per_document=2 cap compared with uncapped
quality_scoring: A hit requires the frozen document key, version, locale, heading, and literal evidence marker in the retrieved heading plus content; duplicate source hits receive no extra nDCG gain
scope: Each query's pinned version is filtered before ranking; all corpus languages remain eligible
latency: Local warm in-process query retrieval, including neural query inference but excluding model loading and passage embedding build
holdout_rule: Evaluate the locked final strategy once after all DEV decisions; do not retune from HOLDOUT
limitations: The query-level HOLDOUT is retrospective: earlier reports evaluated this entire fixed set, and some DEV/HOLDOUT questions share source topics.
No-answer retrieval candidates are not generated answers; false-answer count cannot be inferred from ranking alone.
The model is experimental and its approximately 471 MB weights are kept in the OS temporary directory, not deployed.
